derivedFrom.guidance: Record the upstream template/version/digest and selected authentication mode. Recompute digests and bump evidence normalization when reviewer, thread, or merge-state composition changes.

cursor.replay: The cursor covers PR identity, creation time, status, source commit, merge status, sorted reviewers, and sorted thread state. An unchanged cursor returns idle.

semantics.terminal: Completed or abandoned PRs return terminal. A terminal transition after successful preflight but before the first attempt returns eventless terminal.
semantics.duplicates: Event IDs are deterministic from PR ID and normalized cursor. Recipients must deduplicate repeated event IDs.

credentials.policy: Select exactly one mode: bearer with AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN or PAT with AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT. Allowlist only the selected variable.

scheduling.maxSafeDowntimeRationale: Current reviewer votes and merge status can change between observations even though threads are durable; six recommended intervals is the conservative bound.
